_source: tsumugi's rule-learning and recall circuits, the loop-pass head knock-outs, and the dynamic- and static-you circuits. Circuits: top-100 neurons by attribution, as position/neuron. Knock-outs set neurons (or heads) to their corpus mean; dose .5 moves them half way. Scores: fluid and recall AUCs; dynamic and static you are the Atlas speaker-swap gauge and kappa cell. Damage-matched random sets are 32 times larger, with equal or greater next-token damage.
